in_tamil.name: தத்த
in_tamil.long_meaning: இயல்வாடி (provider), வாழ்க்கையில் உட்பட்டவன் (one who is present in the world)

in_marathi.name: Datta
in_marathi.long_meaning: Datta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Lord Datta is known as the giver, donor, and preserver. He is a form of Lord Mahadeva, and is believed to fulfill the desires of his devotees.

in_bengali.name: Datta
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Giver, Donor
in_bengali.long_meaning: Datta একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Hindu mythology, Lord Datta is known as the giver, donor, and preserver. He is a form of Lord Mahadeva, and is believed to fulfill the desires of his devotees.
